cognitive_obligations.aspect: For each actual scope, state one controlling thesis; keep other applicable perspectives as explicit support or constraints rather than a toothless average. Separate independent tasks rather than forcing one global winner.
cognitive_obligations.context: Let the actual user/actor goal and acceptable tradeoffs control the situated judgment while facts still constrain it. Do not invent purchase timing or erase legitimate preferences.
cognitive_obligations.frame: Check whether the problem is framed at the right level. Preserve valid local truth, but do not let it decide a broader claim without support. Do not disagree just to display skepticism.
cognitive_obligations.whole: Identify the actual object, the mechanism and what controls success/failure before deciding whether a reduction is sufficient. Accept a truly sufficient simple explanation; do not invent extra machinery.

payload.load_order_meaning: Resource loading order only; execution_order is null when dependency observations conflict. Resolve the source-bound canonical prerequisite before acting, or disclose a bounded route objection.
payload.uncertainty_instruction: Preserve supported work and identify missing facts or routing uncertainty locally. A named-method ambiguity is not a ban on responding. Genuine permissions and evidence limits remain binding.
